Dispatcher: Ordinary spell for the handlers
Coordinator: Keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm and steady today.
Handler: I am checking carrier tags, vet notes, and the fit of each crate.
Planner: Make sure every traveler gets the same clear guidance before check-in.
Dispatcher: The ground team should move carriers gently between services and avoid sudden stops.
Coordinator: If a pet looks stressed, slow the handoff and give the owner a quick update.
Handler: I will watch for secure latch closures and clean bedding before each transfer.
Planner: Mina Rossi and Talia Suleiman may need extra reassurance at the counter.
Dispatcher: Use plain language, keep the tone warm, and do not rush the conversation.
Coordinator: If Mochi arrives, confirm comfort items are packed and visible on the manifest.
Handler: I will review water access, ventilation, and spacing around the carrier row.
Planner: When the lounge gets busy, stagger the escort flow and keep the aisle clear.
Dispatcher: Aurelia Skyways expects tidy records and careful notes on every companion animal case.
Coordinator: If a traveler has special handling needs, flag it early and brief the next shift.
Handler: I will double-check labels against the booking page and the front desk handoff.
Planner: Keep the desk stocked with forms, wipes, and spare seals for routine use.
Dispatcher: The best work here is quiet, patient, and consistent across the whole shift.
Coordinator: Stay alert, speak softly, and make sure each animal moves safely through the day.
